abstract_ko: 본 연구는 챗봇을 활용한 중국어 교육용 프로그램 개발의 기초 자료를 제공하기 위해 외국어 교육에서 활용 가능한 인공지능 기술에 대해 알아보고, 최근 급속도로 발달하고 있는 외국어 교육용 챗봇의 발달 현황과 교육현장에서의 활용 사례를 살펴보았다. 이를 통해 메신저 인터페이스를 활용한 챗봇 서비스를 국내 중국어 교육에 도입하여, 국내의 중국어 학습용 챗봇 설계방안을 마련하고, 또 이를 활용하는 관련 교육 프로그램과 중국어 교육현장에서 적용 가능한 교수-학습 방안을 제안하여 향후 중국어 교육 분야에서의 챗봇 활용 수업에 대한 가능성을 살펴보았다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the possibility of using artificial intelligence (AI)chatbot in Chinese class curriculum of university education in Korea. A chatbot using mobile phone and SNS service might be the one of theattractive and useful tools to foreign language learners. This study is to provide basic data for developing Chinese language education programs using chatbots. First, we looked at artificial intelligence technologies that can be used in foreign language education, and looked at the development status of chatbots for foreign language education, which are rapidly developing in recent years, and their use cases in the educational field. Based on this result, we are going to use a chatbot service using a messenger interface for Chinese education in Korea. The aims of this, propose a plan to design a chatbot for learning Chinese in Korea, also propose related educational programs using this and teaching-learning methods applicable in the field of Chinese language education.

title_ko: The Impact of Utilizing AI Chatbots on Elementary English Learners' Willingness to Communicate and Affective Factors
title_en: The Impact of Utilizing AI Chatbots on Elementary English Learners' Willingness to Communicate and Affective Factors
kw_en: AI Chatbots; Willingness to Communicate (WTC); Confidence; Anxiety; Elementary English Learners
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of AI chatbot interactions on elementary English learners’ willingness to communicate (WTC), confidence, and anxiety. Conducted with 23 fifth-grade EFL students in South Korea, the research utilized Replika, a text-based chatbot, over a 14-week intervention. Results showed significant improvements in learners' confidence and reductions in anxiety, highlighting the chatbot's potential to create an affectively supportive and engaging environment. However, there was no statistical significance in WTC. Qualitative data indicated that the gamified features motivated learners, while challenges included difficulties in understanding complex chatbot responses. Pedagogical implications emphasize the importance of providing modified and comprehensible input, teacher scaffolding, and multimodal interaction formats to enhance learning outcomes. The findings suggest that while AI chatbots can positively influence affective factors, further research is needed to explore their impact on oral communication and linguistic proficiency.

title_ko: 중한 기계번역 포스트에디팅 가이드라인에 관한 예비연구: 포스트에디팅 교육을 위한 가이드라인

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 교육현장에 활용할 수 있는 중국어-한국어 포스트에디팅 가이드라인 제시를 위한 예비연구이다. 이를 위해 국내 포스트에디팅 교육 관련 선행연구의 포스트에디팅 가이드라인 현황을 살펴보고, 국내외 다양한 포스트에디팅 가이드라인 연구를 종합 분석한 후 이 중 국내 선행연구에서 제시한 영어-한국어 기계번역 포스트에디팅 가이드라인을 선정하여 실제 중국어-한국어 학부생 번역 수업에 적용하였다. 학생들은 제시된 포스트에디팅 가이드라인을 참고하여 중국어-한국어 기계번역 포스트에디팅 과제를 수행하였으며, 학생들이 제출한 포스트에디팅 결과물을 토대로 중국어-한국어 기계번역 포스트에디팅 수행 시 기존 가이드라인에서 수정 보완이 필요한 사항을 고찰하였다. 본 연구는 선행연구 대다수가 실무 차원 포스트에디팅 가이드라인을 다룬 상황에서 교육을 위한 포스트에디팅 가이드라인 연구를 진행하였다는 점에서 의미를 가진다. 또한, 중국어-한국어 언어 쌍에서 처음 시도된 기계번역 포스트에디팅 연구라는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study aims to suggest basic Chinese-to-Korean post-editing guidelines for use in the classroom. To this end, various post-editing guidelines are analyzed through literature review. Based on this analysis a English-to-Korean post-editing guideline is chosen, and applied to a Chinese-to-Korean translation practice of undergraduate students. Students carry out post-editing assignments by referring to the suggested guidelines, and their post-editing assignments are analyzed to see whether the guidelines is applicable for Chinese-to-Korean post-editing. Based on its findings, this study tailors the guidelines to suit post-editing training needs, and suggests Chinese-to-Korean post-editing guidelines with pragmatic examples. The implication of this study is to put forward a first Chinese-to-Korean post-editing guidelines for use in the classroom based on an empirical method.

title_ko: From No Aid to Neural Aids: Exploring the Influence of Machine Translation on L2 Reading Problems
title_en: From No Aid to Neural Aids: Exploring the Influence of Machine Translation on L2 Reading Problems
kw_en: machine translation; second language reading; reading problems; second language proficiency
abstract_ko: Neural machine translators (NMTs), such as Google Translate, may assist second language (L2) readers with general comprehension. However, previous empirical studies show mixed results regarding their effectiveness. In this study, 145 Korean English learners from a girls’ high school were asked to solve three types of reading comprehension problems (grammar judgment, inferring meaning from context, inferring main idea) under three reading conditions (no aid, MT, glossary). Overall, when using MT, reading comprehension scores were higher than in either the no aid or glossary conditions individually. However, none of the reading aid conditions improved grammar judgment. Only mid-proficiency learners benefited from MT in both inferring meaning from context and inferring main idea tasks. The results suggest that the glossary may have interrupted the flow of the reading process. With the widespread availability of MT as an online reference tool, L2 teachers should consider incorporating MT as a legitimate reading aid for different proficiency levels and reading purposes.

title_ko: 살아있는 중국어 교재를 만드는 LLM —소셜미디어 텍스트의 교육적 변용—
title_en: LLMs for Living Chinese Teaching Materials: A Pedagogical Transformation of Social Media Texts
kw_en: Large Language Model (LLM); Social Media Text; Internet Slang; Chinese Language Education; Customized Text; ChineseRealTalk
abstract_ko: This study explores a methodology for converting Chinese social media texts into educational materials using Large Language Models (LLMs) and proposes an interactive platform called ChineseRealTalk. In Chinese language education, there has been a persistent gap between the language presented in textbooks and the authentic everyday language used by native speakers on social media platforms. Despite the pedagogical value of social media texts that reflect the linguistic sensibilities of contemporary learners, incorporating such materials into the classroom remains challenging, as manually adapting them to match learners’ proficiency levels and preparing customized learning texts require considerable time and effort. To address this issue, this study developed ChineseRealTalk by leveraging the contextual understanding and text generation capabilities of LLMs. The platform offers three core functions: Level-based Text Converter, which rewrites original texts according to HSK levels; Neologism and Difficult Expression Annotator, which provides pinyin and example sentences for unfamiliar expressions; and Comprehension Check Question Generator, which automatically produces multiple-choice quizzes and discussion topics. While the platform significantly reduces teachers' preparation time, the study also identifies several limitations, including LLM hallucinations, the loss of cultural context, and delays in reflecting the latest linguistic trends due to knowledge cutoff. Ultimately, LLMs function most effectively as draft generators for instructional materials. However, their effective use depends on teachers’ active curatorial competence, including the critical evaluation of generated outputs and the careful design of prompts.

title_ko: AI 피드백 효용성이 영어 쓰기 성취감에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Impact of AI Feedback Efficacy on English Writing Achievement
kw_en: AI Feedback; Efficacy; Achievement; AI Tool; AWE; English Writing
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 대학 영어쓰기 수업에서 AI 툴이 제공하는 피드백을 활용하였을 때 학습자가 인식하는 피드백 효용감이 쓰기 자신감, AI 툴 만족도, 쓰기 성취감의 영향 관계를 구조방정식 모델을 활용하여 검증해보고자 하였다. 쓰기 과정에서 학습자들은 초안을 작성하고 초안에 대한 AI 툴의 피드백을 받아서 그것을 바탕으로 최종 작문을 과제로 제출하였다. 학기말에 설문응답을 통해 최종 99명으로부터 데이터를 수집하여 SmartPLS로 분석하였다. 효용감, 자신감, 성취감의 항목은 문법, 어휘, 문장구조, 문단구성, 구두점, 내용, 전체적인 작문 등으로 구성되었다. 분석 결과, AI 피드백에 대한 효용감은 학습자들의 영어 작문 자신감과 AI 도구에 대한 만족도에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤으나, 학업 성취감에는 직접적인 영향을 미치지 않았다. 한편, AI 피드백 효용감은 쓰기 자신감을 매개로 쓰기 성취감에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤으나, 쓰기 자신감과 AI 툴 만족도를 동시에 매개로 할 경우에는 학업 성취감에 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 AI피드백의 활용 수업에서 교수자와 학습자의 역할, 그리고 AI 툴의 발전 방향을 논하였다.
abstract_en: This study uses a structural equation model to examine the perceived usefulness of AI-generated feedback in a college English writing course to determine the impact of AI on writing confidence, the satisfaction with AI tools, and the extent of writing achievement. During the writing process, students drafted compositions, received AI-generated feedback on their drafts, and submitted a final version based on that feedback. Data were collected from 99 students through surveys conducted at the end of the semester, which were analyzed using SmartPLS. The constructs of perceived usefulness, confidence, and achievement included aspects such as grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, paragraph organization, punctuation, content, and overall writing. Results show that the perceived usefulness of AI feedback positively influenced writing confidence and students' satisfaction with AI tools, but did not have a direct impact on writing achievement. However, perceived usefulness indirectly influenced writing achievement through writing confidence as a mediating factor. In contrast, when both writing confidence and AI tool satisfaction were included as mediators, the effect on writing achievement was not significant. Based on these findings, this study discusses the roles of instructors and students in AI-assisted writing instruction, as well as future directions for AI tool development.

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 TOPIK 논증 글쓰기의 구조 및 개선 방안
title_en: Structure and Improvement Strategies for TOPIK Argumentative Writing Based on ChatGPT
kw_ko: 텍스트 구조 분석; 논증 글쓰기; 한국어 학습자
kw_en: ChatGPT; TOPIK; text structure analysis; argumentative writing; korean language learner
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 텍스트 구조의 관점에서 ChatGPT를 활용한 TOPIK 논증 글쓰기의 특성을 분석하고, 그 실제 효과를 탐구하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이러한 인공지능 도구의 활용은 오늘날 학습자가 자기 주도적으로 학습하는 데 새로운 가능성을 제공한다. 연구 결과, TOPIK 시험 프롬프트는 ‘전체 요구사항 제시’, ‘배경 및 주제 정보’, ‘지시문제’ 세 가지로 구성되며, 모범답안은 3~4단락 유형으로, 지시문제에 따라 내용이 분포되어 있음을 확인하였다. 또한 무브 3, 4, 8이 고빈도 무브 유형으로 나타났으며, [3-4]와 [8-4] 무브 조합에서 일관성을 보였다. ChatGPT 텍스트 구조를 분석한 결과, 53%의 단락 유형이 참고할 가치가 있었으며, ChatGPT의 텍스트에서 고빈도 무브 사용 및 무브 조합이 모범답안과 큰 일치성이 있음을 확인하였다. 실제 ChatGPT 응답 텍스트 분석 과정에서 ‘과다한 단락 구조’, ‘문제적 본론 구조’, ‘잉여적 결론 구조’ 등 문제점을 확인하고, 개선 방안을 제시하였다. 이 연구는 TOPIK 논증 글쓰기 자가 학습 과정에서 ChatGPT 응답의 텍스트 구조 문제를 도출하고 개선 방안을 제시한 최초의 논의로서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study aims to analyze the characteristics of TOPIK argumentative writing using ChatGPT from the perspective of text structure and to explore its practical effects. The use of such artificial intelligence tools offers new possibilities for self-directed learning among today’s learners. The research findings indicate that the TOPIK prompt consists of three components: ‘overall requirements’, ‘background and topic information’, and ‘instructional questions’. The model answers are structured in 3 to 4 paragraphs, with content distributed according to the instructional questions. High-frequency move types identified include Moves 3, 4, and 8, with consistency observed in move combinations [3-4] and [8-4]. Analysis of ChatGPT’s text structure revealed that 53% of the paragraph types were valuable references, and high-frequency move usage and move combinations in ChatGPT’s texts showed significant alignment with model answers. The analysis of ChatGPT’s response texts identified issues such as ‘excessive paragraph structure’, ‘problematic main body structure’, and ‘superfluous conclusion structure’, and provided suggestions for improvement. This study is significant as it represents the first discussion on identifying and addressing text structure issues in ChatGPT responses for TOPIK argumentative writing self-learning processes.

title_ko: Tracking the Evolution of EFL College Learners’ Interactional Agency in ChatGPT-Mediated Speaking Tasks
title_en: Tracking the Evolution of EFL College Learners’ Interactional Agency in ChatGPT-Mediated Speaking Tasks
kw_en: GenAI/human-AI assemblage/interactional agency/discourse leadership/L2 speaking
abstract_ko: This multi-phase study investigates the seven-week developmental trajectory of interactional agency among EFL college learners (N = 32) in ChatGPT-mediated speaking tasks. Drawing on the human-AI assemblage framework, the research tracks the migration from initial agentic friction to discursive synergy. Data from three time points (T1, T2, T3) were analyzed via one-way repeated measures ANOVA. Results revealed a distinctive reconfiguration of interactional roles. First, learners’ initial mechanical and procedural struggles diminished significantly over time, marked by a sharp decline in both other-initiated repairs and procedural instructions by the final phase. Second, learners’ capacity for strategic interactional monitoring evolved robustly, characterized by a substantial turnover toward autonomous self-initiated repairs. Simultaneously, the density of agentic moves experienced a dramatic surge, reflecting proactive leadership where learners consistently orchestrated thematic transitions and initiations in their turns. Finally, topic durability expanded substantially, validating the successful attainment of sustained and complex conversational architecture. Qualitative triangulation confirmed this profound transition from interactional dependency to autonomous discourse orchestration. Qualitative triangulation confirmed a transition from interactional dependency to autonomous orchestration. Pedagogical implications for scaling this multi-phase developmental model in digital language curricula are discussed, specifically highlighting how educators can systematically scaffold human-AI collaboration.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등학생의 영어 쓰기 활동을 지원하는 생성형 AI 기반 비계 챗봇을 설계하고 수업에 적용하여 그 교육적 가능성을 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 바이브 코딩을 활용하여 초등학교 5 학년 영어교과서에 제시된 글쓰기 과업을 지원하는 맞춤형 비계 챗봇을 설계하였다. 챗봇 개발은 초등영어 쓰기 과업 선정, 글쓰기 비계 챗봇 구안, 설계 코드 생성을 위한 프롬프트 입력, 챗봇 제작 및배포, 챗봇 구동 테스트, 비계 챗봇 활용 수업 모형 개발 등 6단계의 절차로 진행되었다. 이때, 학습자의 정의적 여과망을 낮추기 위해 챗봇의 페르소나는 친절한 영어 쓰기 도우미 선생님으로 설정되었다. 또한, 한 문장씩 완성하여 글을 구성해 나가는 매크로 구조와 목표 문장 작성을 위한 점진적 비계의 마이크로 구조를 챗봇과의 상호작용에 적용하여, 학습자의 인지 부담을 줄이고 주도적인 쓰기를지원하였다. 개발된 챗봇은 초등학교 5학년 학생들을 대상으로 ‘도입-준비1-준비2-실행-정리’의 5단계 수업 모형으로 적용되었다. 수업 적용 결과, 학생들은 영어 쓰기 과업에서 어휘, 문법, 내용 선정등에서 어려움을 겪었으나, 챗봇이 제공하는 맞춤형 비계를 통해 이를 점진적으로 극복하는 모습을보였다. 또한 학생들은 챗봇의 비계를 무비판적으로 수용하기보다는, 자신의 의도에 맞지 않는 비계는거부하고 챗봇의 비계 수정에 필요한 정보를 제공하는 등 챗봇과의 상호작용에서 주도적인 역할을 수행하였다. 본 연구는 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 챗봇 개발과 수업 모형 간의 유기적 연계, 챗봇 개발 과정을 통한 영어교사의 디지털 교수 역량 및 융합적 전문성 강화, 그리고 학습자의 과잉 의존을 방지하기 위한 AI 기반 교육 생태계 조성의 중요성을 확인하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the potential of generative AI-based scaffolding chatbots designed to support primary school students’ English writing. To this end, two customized scaffolding chatbots were developed via vibe coding to assist with two writing tasks from a fifth-grade English textbook. The development process followed a six-step procedure: selecting writing tasks, designing scaffolding chatbots, inputting prompts for code generation (=vibe coding), producing and deploying the chatbots, testing their operation, and developing a lesson model. The chatbot persona was established as a kind English writing assistant teacher to lower learners’ affective filters. Furthermore, the chatbot interaction was designed with a macro-structure for sentence-by-sentence composition and a micro-structure for stepwise scaffolding to reduce cognitive load and support autonomous writing. The developed chatbots were implemented in fifth-grade English classes through a five-stage lesson model: introduction, preparation 1, preparation 2, implementation, and wrap-up. The results demonstrated that students, despite facing challenges in vocabulary, grammar, and content selection, gradually overcame these difficulties through tailored scaffolding. Notably, learners took a proactive role in interactions by rejecting inappropriate scaffolds and providing information to refine the AI’s suggestions rather than accepting them unconditionally. These findings highlight the importance of forging an organic connection between chatbot development and lesson models, enhancing English teachers’ digital competency and adaptive expertise, and cultivating an AI-based educational ecosystem that prevents learners’ over-reliance.

title_ko: 학부 유학생의 대학 생활 한국어 말하기를 위한 인공지능 챗봇 활용 연구 ― 시나리오 기반 챗봇 개발을 중심으로 ―

kw_ko: 한국어 말하기; 학부 유학생; 대학 생활 한국어; 시나리오 기반 챗봇; 인공지능
kw_en: Korean Speaking; International Undergraduates; Korean for University Life; Scenario-Based Chatbot; Artificial Intelligence
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국어 초·중급 학부 유학생들을 대상으로 대학 생활에 필요한 말하기 능력을 향상시키기 위해 시나리오 기반 챗봇을 Dialogflow으로 구현하고 교양 한국어 수업에 적용한 사례를 분석하였다. 이를 위해 대학 생활 관련 교재 7종을 분석하여 학생증 발급, 수강 신청, 도서관 이용, 동아리 활동, 학교생활의 다섯 가지 주제를 도출하였으며, 각 주제를 단계적 발화 연습이 가능하도록 설계하였다. 수업에 참여한 초급 학부 유학생 29명의 발화 로그를 CAF(Complexity, Accuracy, Fluency) 모델을 기준으로 분석한 결과, 과제가 누적될수록 평균 발화 길이와 어휘 다양도, 발화량이 꾸준히 증가하였으며, 오류의 양상에서도 기초 문법 오류에서 복합문 구성 오류로의 질적 변화가 나타났다. 이는 학습자들의 의사소통 능력이 점진적으로 향상되었음을 보여주는 실증적 근거로 해석된다. 또한 설문 및 개방형 응답 분석 결과, 학습자들은 챗봇을 통해 발화 기회를 확대하고 발음 점검과 학습 동기 향상에 긍정적 효과를 경험한 것으로 나타났다. 그러나 발화 인식률, 대화 흐름의 다양성, 자동 피드백 기능 등의 기술적·교육적 보완이 필요하며, 향후 연구에서는 발화 데이터 기반의 시나리오 확장과 피드백 알고리즘 고도화를 통해 학습 효과를 한층 강화할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study analyzes a case in which a scenario-based chatbot was implemented using Dialogflow and applied in a liberal arts Korean class to improve the speaking skills required for university life among beginner–intermediate international undergraduates. To develop the chatbot, seven university-life Korean textbooks were reviewed, from which five core themes were extracted: student ID issuance, course registration, library use, club activities, and general campus life. Each theme was designed to enable gradual speaking practice through a structured progression. Speech logs from 29 beginner-level international undergraduates who participated in the class were analyzed using the CAF (Complexity, Accuracy, Fluency) framework. As tasks accumulated, students showed consistent improvement in average utterance length, lexical diversity, and overall speech quantity. Error patterns also shifted qualitatively—from basic grammatical errors to errors involving complex sentence construction—indicating progressive development in learners’ communicative competence. Furthermore, survey responses and open-ended feedback revealed that learners perceived the chatbot as helpful for increasing speaking opportunities, checking pronunciation, and enhancing learning motivation. However, the findings also highlight the need for technological and pedagogical improvements, such as higher speech recognition accuracy, more flexible dialogue flows, and stronger automated feedback capabilities. Future research should explore expanding scenario coverage based on learner speech data and refining feedback algorithms to further enhance learning outcomes.

title_ko: 내용중심 영어 교수 학습의 도구로서 ChatGPT의 활용 가능성 탐색
title_en: Exploring the potential of using ChatGPT as a content-based English learning and teaching tool
kw_ko: 교육에서의 인공지능; 챗GPT; 클레버봇; 쿠키; 챗봇; 내용중심교수법
kw_en: AIED; ChatGPT; Cleverbot; Kuki; Chatbot; CBI
abstract_ko: This study investigates the feasibility of using chatbots as a content-based English learning and teaching tool. To this end, researchers asked 27 education experts to complete structured questionnaires about three chatbots: Cleverbot, Kuki, and ChatGPT. Based on their responses, the researchers concluded that ChatGPT demonstrates relatively superior performance in information provision and language proficiency but received a low rating for social skills and moral discernment. While existing chatbots such as Cleverbot and Kuki are programmed to hold everyday conversations, ChatGPT was developed with a deep learning method using a huge language model which empowered ChatGPT to provide a variety of information and have excellent multilingual abilities. Thus, ChatGPT can be used very effectively for content-based English learning and teaching through problem-solving activities, by utilizing its ability to provide information and to create learning and teaching materials. In addition, ChatGPT is expected to be used as a self-directed learning tool for learners and as a teaching aid for teachers in the future.

title_ko: Impact of Feedback Combinations from a Teacher, AI, and Self on EFL English Writing and Perceptions via ZOOM
title_en: Impact of Feedback Combinations from a Teacher, AI, and Self on EFL English Writing and Perceptions via ZOOM
kw_en: Process Writing; Teacher Feedback; AI Feedback; Self-Feedback; Students’ Perception
abstract_ko: This study aimed to investigate the influence of feedback combinations on English writing performance and student perceptions in an online writing course conducted via Zoom during the COVID-19 pandemic. Sixty-eight college participants were divided into two groups: a control group of 33 students, who received only AI and teacher feedback during the writing process, and an experimental group of 35 students, who engaged in self-feedback before receiving AI and teacher feedback. To assess the effectiveness of the different types of feedback, students took TOEFL writing test respectively at the beginning and end of the semester. Additionally, to investigate learners’ perceptions towards different types of feedback, a post-questionnaire was administered to capture participants’ thoughts on them. The results revealed that the post-writing performance of both groups showed improvement from the pre-test scores. Notably, the group that received self-feedback demonstrated significant enhancement compared to the group without self-feedback. In addition, the group with self-feedback showed a positive perception towards self-feedback. Subsequently, students expressed their views on the advantages and disadvantages of each feedback. The study highlights the educational implications of using combined feedback methods.

title_en: Strategies for Developing AI Digital Korean Language Instructional Materials to Enhance Material Flexibility: Focusing on the case of King Sejong Institute Materials
kw_ko: 디지털 교재(Digital Instructional Materials); AI 디지털 교재(AI Digital Instructional Materials); 한국어 교재(Korean Language instructional materials); 유연성(Flexibility); 종이책(Print-based materials); 모듈형 설계(Modular Design); 세종학당(King Sejong Institute)
abstract_ko: This study explores development strategies for AI digital Korean materials aimed at ensuring flexibility. Language instructional materials development must account for the diverse characteristics of learners and the varied environments of educational fields. While developers have continuously strived to ensure this flexibility, paper-based materials have been constrained by a lack of adaptable methods and limited ease in module implementation. To address these limitations, this study proposes a design strategies for AI digital Korean materials to enhance flexibility. If modules that support diverse adaptation methods are designed, AI technology is utilized to provide a technical foundation for flexible modification, and offer user-friendly interfaces to ease the implementation of flexibility, it will be possible to provide adaptable Korean materials that can be utilized by learners worldwide.

title_ko: AI 시대, 미국 대학 한국어 수업의 정체성 재정립 -‘AI를 어떻게 활용할 것인가’에서 ‘왜 교실인가’로-
title_en: Redefining the Identity of Korean Language Classrooms in U.S. Universities: From “How to Use AI” to “Why the Classroom?”
kw_ko: AI 시대의 한국어 교육; 미국 대학의 한국어 교육; 위임-강화 모델; 기능적 정당성; 사회적 실천

abstract_ko: This study examines the structural crisis facing Korean language education in U.S. universities in the Age of AI and explores ways to redefine the unique identity of in-person classes. Analysis of the 2021 AATK survey data reveals that advanced Korean courses remain largely confined to the traditional paradigm of proficiency management and functional refinement. This structure directly overlaps with the linguistic performance capabilities of AI, thereby undermining the functional legitimacy of in-person classes. In response, this study proposes redefining language as a social practice rather than a mere set of functional skills. It introduces the ‘Delegate-Amplify Model,’ which delegates routine tasks such as summarization and proofreading to AI while amplifying interpersonal interaction and the social responsibility of speech within the physical classroom. Furthermore, it suggests instructional designs that transform AI outputs into materials for critical analysis and specifies subjective learning experiences through interdisciplinary integration and metalinguistic reflection. This study emphasizes that the Korean language classroom in the AI era must be redesigned as an irreplaceable educational space that fosters subjective linguistic agency beyond functional mastery.

title_ko: 基于ChatGPT的汉语会话课程设计以及教学效果研究
title_en: Research on Chinese Conversation Course Design and Teaching Effect Based on ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; Natural Language Processing; Chinese Language Teaching; Conversation Class; Artificial Intelligence; Teaching Effectiveness; 人工智能，自然语言处理， 汉语教学，会话课，教学效果
abstract_ko: 随着人工智能（AI）技术的快速发展，特别是自然语言处理领域的进步，智能语言助手在教育中的应用越来越广泛。ChatGPT作为一种大型语言模型，能够为学习者提供互动的语言交流环境，尤其适用于语言学习。本文旨在探讨如何利用ChatGPT设计汉语会话课程，并通过实践检验其在汉语教学中的效果。通过对实际教学过程的观察与分析发现，基于ChatGPT的汉语会话课不仅能够提升学习者的语言表达能力，还能增强其学习兴趣和自主性。
abstract_en: With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence(AI)technology, particularly advancements in the field of Natural Language Processing(NLP), the application of intelligent language assistants in education is becoming increasingly widespread. As a large language model, ChatGPT can provide learners with an interactive language exchange environment, making it especially suitable for language learning. This paper aims to explore how to design Chinese conversation courses using ChatGPT and empirically examine its effectiveness in Chinese language teaching. Observations and analyses of the actual teaching process reveal that ChatGPT-based Chinese conversation classes not only improve learners' language expression abilities but also enhance their interest and autonomy in learning.

title_ko: 이주배경학생 대상 AI 활용 토픽 수업 운영 방안 탐색
title_en: Exploring AI-Assisted TOPIK Instruction for Students from Migrant Backgrounds
kw_en: Artificial intelligence; Korean language education; Test of Proficiency in Korean(TOPIK); migrant students
abstract_ko: 정부는 교육 현장에 AI 기술을 적극적으로 도입하여 학습의 효율성을 극대화하고, 학습자 개인의 특성과 요구를 고려한 맞춤형 교육 환경을 제공하는 것을 목표로 한다. 이러한 점은 급속히 증가하는 이주배경학생들을 위한 한국어 교육에서 그 효과를 기대할 수 있다. 단순히 의사소통을 넘어 학습 목적 한국어로 접근해야 하는 이주배경학생들을 위한 한국어 수업에서 AI 활용은 필수적인 요소로 인식된다. 이러한 흐름을 반영하여 이 연구는 안산시 K 특성화 고등학교에 재학 중인 이주배경학생 20명을 대상으로 AI를 활용한‘한국어 수업 –토픽’수업 설계를 제안하고 실시하였다. 토픽 기출문제를 수업 텍스트로 선정해 어휘, 읽기, 말하기, 쓰기, 평가 영역에 생성형 AI를 활용한 수업을 구성하고 진행한 후 AI 활용 수업에 대한 학습자의 경험과 인식을 살펴보고 인지적·기능적·정의적 측면에서 질적으로 분석하였다. 학습자들은 AI를 활용한 토픽 수업에 높은 만족도를 보였으며, 다수의 학습자는 AI 활용 수업이 기존 수업에 비해 학습 내용을 이해하고 반복 연습을 하는 데 효과적이며, 시간과 장소의 제약 없이 자기주도적 학습이 가능하다고 응답하였다. 또한 AI가 교사의 피드백을 보조함으로써 수업의 만족도와 교사–학습자 상호작용이 향상되었고, 흥미와 학습 동기 부여에도 긍정적으로 작용한 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 점은 학습자 집단의 상황에 맞는 맞춤형 학습을 제공할 수 있는 가능성을 시사한다.
abstract_en: The government aims to maximize the efficiency of learning by actively introducing AI technology into the educational field and provide a customized educational environment that considers individual characteristics and needs of learners. This can be expected to be effective in Korean language education for rapidly increasing students from migrant backgrounds. The use of AI is essential in Korean language classes for youth from migrant backgrounds who have to approach Korean for learning purposes beyond simply communicating. Reflecting this trend, this paper proposed and conducted a 'Korean language class-TOPIK' class model using AI for 20 migrant students enrolled in K-vocational high school in Ansan City. After selecting the previous TOPIK question as the text of the class, composing and conducting a class using a Generative AI in the areas of vocabulary, reading, speaking, writing, and evaluation, the satisfaction of the TOPIK class using AI was investigated through in-depth interviews, analyzing in terms of cognitive, functional, and affective aspects. It was found that the learners showed high satisfaction with the TOPIK class using AI, and that AI assisted the role of a teacher to improve the satisfaction of class and to interact between teachers and learners. This suggests the possibility of providing customized learning tailored to the situation of the learner group.

abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 머신러닝과 딥러닝 언어모델을 활용하여 한국어 학습자 쓰기의 주제를 자동으로 분류할 수 있을지 그 가능성을 탐색해 보는 데 있다. 머신러닝 기반의 언어모델인 랜덤 포레스트를 기준 모델로 삼아 딥러닝 기반의 언어모델의 한국어 학습자 쓰기 주제 분류 성능을 평가해 보았는데 머신러닝 기반의 언어모델인 랜덤 포레스트의 경우 정확도가 약 96.5%로 나타났다. 반면에 딥러닝 기반의 언어모델인 KoBERT의 정확도는 약 64.25%로 랜덤 포레스트에 비해 훨씬 낮은 정확도를 보였으며 KoELECTRA의 정확도는 약 97.25%로 랜덤 포레스트와 비교해 약간 높은 정확도를 보였다. 3가지 모델 간의 주제 예측 결과를 비교해 본 결과 KoBERT의 경우, 낮은 정확도에서도 알 수 있듯이 인간의 직관으로 이해가 어려운 예측 결과를 보였고 나머지 두 모델이 정확히 주제를 예측한 작문에 대해서도 예측을 실패한 사례가 나타났다. 랜덤 포레스트와 KoELECTRA의 경우에는 예측 오류 양상에 있어서 비슷한 양상을 보였는데 두 알고리듬 간의 성능 차이는 크지 않았다. 3가지 알고리듬에서 공통적으로 나타난 예측 오류 양상은 주제에 특화된 어휘가 주로 사용되는 작문이 아닌 일반적으로 흔히 쓰이는 어휘가 주로 사용되는 작문의 경우에 주제 판별 성능이 떨어진다는 점이다. 또한, 작문의 일부 내용이 다른 주제의 내용을 포함하고 있을 때 주제 예측에 실패하는 사례들이 많이 나타났다. 이러한 한계점을 극복하기 위해서는 다양한 장르의 작문을 세부적으로 분석할 필요가 있으며 기존 구축된 학습자의 작문을 활용하는 방법론 외에 다양한 방법론에 대한 실험이 지속되어야 할 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the possibility of automatically classifying the topics of Korean language learners’ writings using machine learning and deep learning. The Random Forest model, serving as a baseline, achieved an accuracy of 96.5%. In contrast, compared to the baseline, the deep learning model KoBERT showed lower accuracy at 64.25%, while KoELECTRA slightly outperformed the baseline with 97.25% accuracy. When comparing the topic prediction results of the three models, KoBERT demonstrated prediction outcomes that deviated from human intuition, failing to accurately predict topics that were correctly identified by the other two models, as evidenced by its low accuracy. The Random Forest and KoELECTRA exhibited similar tendencies in terms of error patterns, with no significant difference in performance between the two algorithms. Common prediction errors across the three algorithms included difficulties in classifying writings that used general vocabulary instead of topic-specific terms. Additionally, the models often failed to predict the topic accurately when the content included vocabulary related to other topics. To improve performance, a detailed analysis of various writing genres and continuous experimentation using new data and methodologies are necessary

title_ko: Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz
title_en: Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 상호문화 소통 능력; 외국어로서의 독일어; 프롬프트 설계; 교수자의 역할
kw_en: generative KI; DaF-Unterricht; interkulturelle Kompetenz; Promptgestaltung; Rolle der Lehrenden
abstract_ko: In jüngerer Zeit wächst das wissenschaftliche Interesse an der Integration generativer KI-Anwendungen in den Fremdsprachenunterricht. Während erste Studien im Bereich DaF überwiegend auf die Anwendung von KI in der Grammatikund Schreibdidaktik fokussieren, fehlt bislang eine systematische Auseinandersetzung mit ihrem Potenzial zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz. Diese Forschungslücke greift der vorliegende Beitrag auf. Ziel der Untersuchung war es, didaktische Möglichkeiten aufzuzeigen, wie generative KI – insbesondere durch gezielte Promptgestaltung und pädagogische Begleitung – die Entwicklung interkultureller Handlungsfähigkeit im DaF-Unterricht unterstützen kann. Im theoretischen Teil wurden zentrale Begriffe wie „generative KI im DaF-Kontext“ und „interkulturelle Kompetenz als Bildungsziel“ definiert und in den aktuellen Forschungsstand eingebettet. Das dritte Kapitel beleuchtet die Rolle der Lehrenden als interkulturelle Vermittler: innen sowie die Bedeutung einer reflektierten Promptgestaltung. Es wird betont, dass Lehrende nicht nur als Technikanwender agieren, sondern KI bewusst, kritisch und lernzielorientiert einsetzen müssen. Ethische Herausforderungen wie algorithmische Verzerrung, mangelnde Transparenz und Datenverantwortung wurden ebenfalls thematisiert. Im vierten Kapitel werden praxisnahe Unterrichtsmodelle vorgestellt, in denen KI als unterstützendes Medium für Perspektivwechsel, Reflexion und interkulturelle Mediation fungiert. Dabei kommen sowohl kontrastive Landeskunde-Aufgaben als auch KI-gestützte Rollenspiele zum Einsatz, die eine vertiefte Auseinandersetzung mit kultureller Differenz ermöglichen. Insgesamt zeigt die Untersuchung, dass generative KI kein Ersatz, sondern ein begleitendes didaktisches Mittel zur Erweiterung interkultureller Bildungsprozesse sein kann – vorausgesetzt, sie wird im Zusammenspiel mit technischer, didaktischer und ethischer Kompetenz verantwortungsvoll in den Unterricht eingebunden.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 대학 수학 목적 한국어 교육용 교재 개발 방안 연구
title_en: Developing AI-Generated Korean Language Learning Materials for Academic Purposes —A Study on Prompt Engineering and Text Generation—

kw_en: AI-assisted Korean Language Education; Generative AI; Prompting; Textbook Development; Educational Texts (Dialogues)
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능(AI)을 활용한 한국어 교육용 텍스트(대화문 및 설명문) 생성 방법과 프롬프트 설계 전략을 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 OpenAI의 ChatGPT 4o 모델을 활용하여 초급 및 전공 기반 대화문과 설명문 텍스트를 생성하고, 프 롬프트 조건에 따른 생성 결과의 특징과 교육적 적합성을 분석하였다. 실험 결과, AI가 설 정된 조건에 따라 목표 어휘 및 문법을 포함한 텍스트를 생성할 수 있으나, 학습자의 수준 과 완전히 일치하지 않는 경우가 있어 교사의 검토가 필수적임을 확인하였다. 또한 프롬프트의 구체성이 생성 결과의 질에 중요한 영향을 미쳤으며, 설명문보다 대화문에서 보다 정교한 설계가 요구되었다. 본 연구는 AI 기반 한국어 교육 자료 개발의 가능성을 제시하고 향후 프롬프트 설계 및 교육적 효과 검증을 위한 후속 연구의 필요성을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore methods for generating Korean language educational texts—specifically dialogues and expository texts—using generative artificial intelligence (AI), as well as strategies for designing effective prompts. To this end, OpenAI’s ChatGPT-4o model was utilized to generate beginner-level dialogues, major-specific dialogues, and major-specific expository texts. The study analyzed the characteristics of the generated outputs and their educational appropriateness based on different prompt conditions. The results revealed that while the AI could produce texts incorporating target vocabulary and grammar in accordance with specified prompts, teacher review was essential due to occasional mismatches with learners’ proficiency levels. Furthermore, the specificity of the prompts had a significant impact on the quality of the generated texts, and more sophisticated prompt design was required for dialogues than for expository texts. This study suggests the potential of AI-based material development in Korean language education and highlights the need for further research on prompt engineering and the validation of instructional effectiveness.

title_ko: 중문학 전공자 대상 ‘AI 리터러시’ 교육에 관한 제언- 중국어 교육과 연계를 중심으로 -
title_en: A Proposal for ‘AI Literacy’ Education for Chinese Language and Literature Majors- Focusing on its Integration with Chinese Language Education -
kw_ko: 중문학 전공; AI 리터러시; AI 리터러시 교육; 중국어-AI 리터러시 연계; 중국어 교육
kw_en: Chinese Language and Literature Major; AI Literacy; AI Literacy Education; Integration of Chinese Language Education and AI Literacy; Chinese Language Education
abstract_ko: 본고에서는 한국의 중문학 전공자가 AI 시대에 능동적으로 대처할 수 있도록 ‘AI 리터러시’ 교육의 필요성을 설명하고, 중국어와 AI 리터러시를 연계하여 교육하는 방안도 모색해 보았다. 이는 앞으로 중문학도 AI에 관심을 두고 교육과 연구를 진행해야 학문의 발전과 경쟁력을 확보할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 중문학 전공자도 AI 관련 역량을 갖추어 융합형 인재로 성장할 수 있기 때문이다. 특히 여기서는 한국의 중문학 전공자를 대상으로 한 AI 리터러시 교육의 경우 중국인 모국어 화자와 다른 교육 방식이 필요함을 설명하였다. 예를 들면, 1ㆍ2학년은 기초 중국어 학습에서 AI 관련 기본 어휘와 문장을 자연스럽게 결합하여 학습하고, 3ㆍ4학년은 중국어 심화 과정과 함께 AI 리터러시를 이해하고 분석하는 별도의 교과 과정을 개설하여 중국어 기반의 AI 전문 지식과 실무 역량을 동시에 함양하는 것으로 제안해 보았다. 이러한 중국어와 AI 리터러시 연계 교육은 한국의 중문학 전공자도 중국어 구사 능력 습득과 향상뿐만 아니라, 앞으로의 시대와 사회에 부합하는 역량과 통찰력을 기르는 데 도움이 될 것으로 생각된다. 또한, 여기서는 AI 시대의 흐름에 따라 한국의 중문학 교육이 나아가야 할 방향도 제안해 보았다. 이를 통해 한국의 중문학에서도 전통적인 교육 방식과 AI 기술이 융합된 새로운 가치를 창출할 수 있다면, 학문적 지평 확장, 직업적 경쟁력 강화 및 미래 사회에 대한 통찰력 함양 등의 다층적인 이점을 얻을 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the imperative for Korean students specializing in Chinese language and literature to actively engage with the challenges and opportunities introduced by the era of artificial intelligence(AI). It underscores the critical importance of AI literacy education and explores methodologies for its integration within Chinese language instruction. The underlying premise is that the advancement and competitiveness of Chinese studies depend on practitioners’ proactive incorporation of AI in their academic and research activities. Moreover, equipping Chinese language majors with AI-related competencies is essential for nurturing interdisciplinary expertise. A central focus of this research is the development of a tailored approach to AI literacy education for Korean students of Chinese, distinct from programs designed for native Chinese speakers. Specifically, it is proposed that underclassmen(freshmen and sophomores) incorporate foundational AI-related vocabulary and sentence structures into their elementary Chinese language curriculum. For upperclassmen(juniors and seniors), the recommendation is to establish specialized courses aimed at deepening their comprehension and analytical skills concerning AI literacy in conjunction with advanced Chinese studies. This pedagogical strategy seeks to foster both AI-specific knowledge grounded in the Chinese language and applicable practical skills. The study contends that this integrated educational framework will not only enhance Korean Chinese majors’ language proficiency but also equip them with the relevant competencies and perspectives necessary for navigating an evolving societal landscape. Furthermore, the paper outlines prospective directions for Chinese studies education in Korea in response to AI-driven trends. By successfully merging traditional educational paradigms with AI technologies, Korean Chinese studies stand to realize multifaceted benefits, including the broadening of academic scope, the strengthening of professional competitiveness, and the cultivation of foresight pertinent to future societal developments.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 쓰기 피드백의 효과와 학습자 반응 분석
title_en: Effects of Generative AI–Based Writing Feedback and Learner Responses
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 쓰기 피드백; 고쳐쓰기; 인간 피드백; 챗지피티
kw_en: Generative AI; writing feedback; revision; human feedback; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 생성형 AI 기반 쓰기 피드백의 교육적 효과와 특성을 검증하기 위해 인간 평가자와 ChatGPT에 의해 산출된 피드백이 고등학생의 논술 답안 고쳐쓰기 성과에 미치는 영향을 비교·분석하였다. 이를 위해 154명의 고등학교 2학년 학생들을 대상으로 준실험적 사전–사후 설계를 적용하여 양적 효과를 분석하고, 학생 인식 설문을 통해 질적 특질을 도출하였다. 분석 결과, AI 피드백의 효과 크기가 인간 피드백에 비해 미세하게 높게 나타났으며, 이원분산분석에서는 쓰기 수준의 주효과만이 유의하게 확인되었다. 질적 분석 결과, AI 피드백은 구체성과 실현 가능성, 체계성과 일관성, 표현 개선 중심이라는 강점을 지니는 반면, 전형성과 메타인지 유도의 한계를 함께 내포하는 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI 피드백이 1차 수정 도구로 활용될 수 있음을 드러내며, 고차적 논증 요소와 메타인지 유도를 위해서는 교사 피드백과의 혼합 활용이 필요함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study compared the effects of feedback generated by human evaluators and ChatGPT on high-school students’ revision performance in argumentative writing to investigate the educational effectiveness and characteristics of generative AI-based writing feedback. A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design was used with 154 second-year high school students to examine quantitative effects and identify qualitative features through a learner perception survey. The results showed that the effect size of AI feedback was slightly larger than that of human feedback, and the two-way ANOVA revealed a significant main effect only for writing proficiency level. According to qualitative analysis, AI feedback demonstrated strengths in specificity, feasibility, systematicity, consistency, and a focus on improving linguistic expression, but it also had limitations related to stereotypical patterns and insufficient support for metacognitive engagement. These results suggest that generative AI feedback can be used effectively as a tool for initial revision, whereas a hybrid approach that combines it with teacher feedback is required to address higher-order argumentative elements and promote metacognitive processes.

title_ko: 프랑스 대학 한국어 학습자의 생성형 인공지능 사용 경험 및 인식 연구 -Inalco를 중심으로-
title_en: A Study on French University Students’ Experiences and Perceptions of Generative AI in Korean Language Learning: The Case of Inalco
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능(Generative AI); 한국어 학습자(Korean Language Learners); 사용 경험(Experiences); 인식(Perceptions); 프랑스 대학(French University)
abstract_ko: This study aims to examine the experiences and perceptions of generative artificial intelligence among students learning Korean at a French university. A survey was conducted with 115 students at Inalco in France, with the goal of providing insights for future teaching and learning strategies. The survey results show that about half of the respondents used generative AI in their Korean learning, with ChatGPT being the most preferred tool. Respondents tended to use generative AI as a supplementary aid rather than relying on it, and they maintained a neutral stance regarding its usefulness, reliability, and contribution to Korean language learning. For the effective integration of generative AI into future teaching and learning design, it is necessary to strengthen learners’ competence in using AI maintaining the essential meaning of “learning.” The study also suggests the need for further expansion of research in this field.

title_ko: 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 기반 중국어 AI 교수·학습 보조 도구 설계 연구 ― 비계설정 이론을 중심으로 ―
title_en: A Study on the Design of Chinese AI Teaching and Learning Assistant Tools Based on Context Engineering: Focused on Scaffolding Theory
kw_ko: 컨텍스트 엔지니어링; 비계설정; 중국어 교육; 대규모 언어 모델; 피드백 설계

abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">This study examines the design of AI-assisted Chinese language learning tools based on Context Engineering (CE) in Korean higher education. Large Language Models exhibit structural English bias, creating a multilingual pathway in Korean Chinese language education that Prompt Engineering alone cannot adequately control. To address this issue, the study proposes a three-layer CE structure-System Prompt (SP), Knowledge, and User Prompt (UP)-and a five-stage CE design model grounded in scaffolding theory (Wood et al., 1976), corrective feedback typology (Lyster & Ranta, 1997), and feedback hierarchy (Hattie & Timperley, 2007). The design of the Chinese pronunciation assessment tool PutongPutong Gems demonstrates how CE can provide more consistent, controllable, and shareable feedback than personalization-based approaches. Tone Visualizer further suggests that CE design principles can extend beyond LLM-based environments. The study concludes that the educational value of CE tools depends primarily on the integration of domain knowledge, CE design competency, and LLM platform literacy rather than coding proficiency.
abstract_en: This study examines the design of AI-assisted Chinese language learning tools based on Context Engineering (CE) in Korean higher education. Large Language Models exhibit structural English bias, creating a multilingual pathway in Korean Chinese language education that Prompt Engineering alone cannot adequately control. To address this issue, the study proposes a three-layer CE structure-System Prompt (SP), Knowledge, and User Prompt (UP)-and a five-stage CE design model grounded in scaffolding theory (Wood et al., 1976), corrective feedback typology (Lyster & Ranta, 1997), and feedback hierarchy (Hattie & Timperley, 2007). The design of the Chinese pronunciation assessment tool PutongPutong Gems demonstrates how CE can provide more consistent, controllable, and shareable feedback than personalization-based approaches. Tone Visualizer further suggests that CE design principles can extend beyond LLM-based environments. The study concludes that the educational value of CE tools depends primarily on the integration of domain knowledge, CE design competency, and LLM platform literacy rather than coding proficiency.

abstract_ko: This conceptual study proposes an ecological reconfiguration of elementary English education in the AI era. It begins from the recognition that elementary English education faces structural challenges, including limited instructional time, learner differences, unequal access to out-of-school English experiences, and the limitations of standardized classroom-based instruction. Against this background, the study reexamines the function-oriented implementation of communicative approaches in the Korean elementary EFL context and argues for a reorientation of elementary English education through the functional integration of CBI, WLA, and TBLT within experience-centered learning ecosystems. To develop this reorientation, this study draws on ecological perspectives on language learning, and reviews key concepts such as affordance, relationality, emergence, contextuality, context-sensitivity, and agency with attention to their implications for elementary English education. It then presents design directions for an expanded English learning ecosystem that connects school, home, after-school, digital, and AI-supported learning environments. Specifically, the study proposes a curriculum-based English learning ecosystem platform, English meaning-making competency as an overarching goal, a content-based integrated syllabus, children’s literary and informational texts in English as core multimodal materials, input-rich and meaning-oriented pedagogy, and process-oriented assessment. The study concludes by discussing implications and future research needs.

title_ko: 인공지능 기술을 기반으로 하는 중국어 교육 분야의 연구 논문 동향 분석
title_en: A Study on the Research Trends in the field of Chinese Language Education based on Artificial Intelligence Technology

abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 국내 학술지에 게재된 인공지능에 기반한 중국어 교육 관련 연구 논문들의 동향을 분석하여 지금까지 어떠한 연구가 이루어져 왔는지 분석하였다. 국내 학술지에 게재된 관련 논문들을 살펴보기 위하여 학술연구정보서비스(RISS)에서 검색하였으며, ‘인공지능’, ‘챗봇’, ‘AI’, ‘로봇’, ‘중국어’, ‘중국어 교육’, ‘인공지능 스피커’, ‘ITS’ 등 키워드를 검색어로 사용하였다. 국내 학술지에 게재된 인공지능에 기반한 중국어 교육 관련 연구 논문을 인공지능 개발, 인공지능 분석, 인공지능 활용의 등 3개의 하위 범주로 나누어 탐색하고 구체적으로 분석한 결과 중국어 교육에서는 인공지능 활용과 관련된 연구가 16편 나타나 중국어 교육 분야에서 나타나는 인공지능 관련 연구의 대부분을 차지하고 있으며 인공지능 개발과 관련된 연구는 3편 나타났다. 다음으로 중국어 교육 분야에서 나타나는 인공지능 관련 연구 논문들을 년도 별로 분석한 결과 국내 중국어 교육 분야에서 인공지능 관련 연구 논문들은 2009년도부터 나타나기 시작하였으며 초창기에는 연구가 간헐적으로 나타나다가 2019년도부터 비교적 본격적으로 연구가 수행되기 시작하였음을 알 수 있었다. 특히 2023년도에는 관련 논문이 이전 해와 비교하여 현저하게 증가하고 있음을 보여주었다. 또한 향후 인공지능과 관련하여 중국어 교육 분야에서 진행되어야 할 연구의 방향을 제안하였다. 구체적으로 챗봇과 관련된 향후 연구 방향에 대하여 살펴보았으며 인공지능 음성인식 기능에 기반한 여러 ITS(Intelligent tutoring system)와 관련된 향후 연구 방향에 대하여 살펴보았다. 또한 인공신경망 기술(NMT)을 기반으로 하는 인공지능 통･번역 프로그램과 관련된 연구 방향을 살펴보았으며 마지막으로 교수자의 교육 보조, 연구 보조, 행정 보조로 활용될 수 있는 인공지능과 관련된 향후 연구 방향을 살펴보았다.
abstract_en: This study analyzed the trends of research papers on AI-based Chinese language education published in Korean journals. We searched the Research Information Service (RISS) for relevant articles published in Korean journals, and used keywords such as ‘artificial intelligence’, ‘chatbot’, ‘AI’, ‘robot’, ‘Chinese’, ‘Chinese education’, ‘artificial intelligence speaker’, and ‘ITS’ as search terms. The research papers related to Chinese language education based on AI published in domestic journals were divided into three subcategories, including AI development, AI analysis, and AI utilization, and analyzed in detail. As a result, 16 studies related to AI utilization in Chinese language education appeared, accounting for the majority of AI-related research in Chinese language education, while 3 studies related to AI development appeared. Next, we analyzed the research papers related to A.I. in the field of Chinese language education by year, and found that research papers related to A.I. in the field of Chinese language education in Korea began to appear in 2009, and while research was intermittent in the early years, research began to be conducted in earnest in 2019. In particular, the number of related papers in 2023 showed a significant increase compared to previous years. We also suggested the direction of future research on A.I. in the field of Chinese language education. Specifically, we looked at future research directions related to various intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) based on AI speech recognition, chatbots, AI translation and interpretation programs based on neural network technology (NMT), and finally, AI that can be used as a teaching assistant, research assistant, and administrative assistant for instructors.
